function id<T>(value:T):T { return value; }
function constId<const T>(value:T):T { return value; }
const a:{x:1}=id({x:2});
const b:{x:'a'|'b'}=id({x:'c'});
const c:{readonly x:{readonly y:1}}=constId({x:{y:2}});
const d: [1, 'hello'] = id([2, 'hello']);
const e = constId({x: { y: 1 }});
e.x.y = 2;
const f: { value: { tag: 'a' } } = { value: { tag: 'a', unknown: 2 } };
function constrained<T extends { flag: boolean }>(value: T): T { return value; }
const result = constrained({ flag: true });
result.flag = false;
